en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a Lutheran church with a tall central tower topped by a spire and cross. The church has a tiled, polygonal roof and narrow arched windows, and is surrounded by trees and a wooden fence with masonry posts. In the foreground, a grassy open space with two children and a dog is visible. At the top is printed text in Cyrillic on the left and in German on the right.
